description.narrative: (Uganda): The Graduating to Resilience activity is a seven year, Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance-funded development food security activity targeting both Congolese refugees and vulnerable Ugandan households in the Kamwenge district of Western Uganda. The activity uses the "graduation into sustainable livelihoods approach"-an intervention that helps extremely poor households overcome multiple deprivations, increase consumption, and develop sustainable livelihoods. The graduation approach is a proven strategy designed to promote economic inclusion through a combination of precise targeting and conditional assistance that is delivered in a series of carefully sequenced interventions. It focuses on building the confidence, capabilities, economic assets, and agency of extremely poor individuals and households in order to improve their resilience to shocks and facilitate their escape from extreme poverty..
